about: Trent Hills is a municipality in Northumberland County, Ontario, on the Trent River and Trent-Severn Waterway, covering Campbellford, Hastings, and Warkworth—not a single city. Lock stations, small-town Main Streets, and farm country sit between Peterborough and Lake Ontario. About 13,000 people live in Trent Hills.
